function.arguments: {"observation": "`arm` and `severity` are strongly associated: clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients, as confirmed by the data dictionary stating treatment was assigned by clinician judgement and not randomised.", "implication": "Because severity is associated with both treatment assignment and response, and because the treatment arm is not randomized, any comparison of response between males and females within the treatment arm must be stratified by severity to avoid confounding. Failure to do so would attribute a difference due to severity to sex, leading to a biased or even opposite conclusion. Therefore, the analysis must stratify by `severity`."}
function.name: note_finding
